terms.designation: Manual of Petroleum Measurement Standards Binders

definitions.content:
This four-volume set of three-ring binders and index tabs will house the chapters and standards that make up the manual. Holders of existing two-binder sets may purchase binders three and four individually. When all the chapters and existing publications (excluding Chapters 11 and 16) are ordered, the binders, index tabs, and table of contents are included free of charge.

Price per set of four, $30.00
